references.text: The same cleansing ritual with two birds, cedar wood, scarlet yarn, and hyssop is used for the cleansing of leprosy in a person, which forms the basis for the ritual described here for the house.
The verses immediately preceding describe the beginning of the cleansing ritual for the house using the same elements: two birds, cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet yarn.
Hyssop is used to apply blood on the doorposts during the Passover in Egypt, illustrating hyssop's role in cleansing and protection.
Cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet yarn are used in the ritual of the red heifer for purification from impurity caused by death, showing similar elements in cleansing rituals.
Living water (מַיִם חַיִּים) is used together with hyssop for cleansing, paralleling the use of living water in Leviticus 14:52.
David asks to be cleansed with hyssop, referring to the cleansing rituals in the Mosaic Law where hyssop was employed for spiritual purification.
The Epistle to the Hebrews refers to the use of scarlet wool and hyssop together with blood for cleansing, linking Old Testament cleansing rituals to Christ's atoning work.
